moa.t: Binds the glucocorticoid receptor and alters gene transcription: anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressive

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Prednisone, oral, 0.5 mg/kg daily. · Taper dose to a suitable maintenance dose. (Refer to Appendix II for an example of a dose reduction regimen.)
Prednisone, oral. · Initial dose: 1 mg/kg daily, until Hb is stable and >10 g/dL. · Taper slowly and monitor Hb at least once weekly. (Refer to Appendix
Prednisone, oral, 1 mg/kg daily until platelet count has normalised. · Taper slowly and monitor platelet count. (Refer to Appendix II for an example of a dose reduction regimen.)
Prednisone, oral, 0.5 mg/kg daily, for ≤ 2 weeks. (Specialist initiated.)
Prednisone, oral 40 mg daily, for up to 10 days, or until discharge.
Prednisone, oral. · Start with 5 mg daily. · Increase to maximum of 7.5 mg daily, if necessary.
Prednisone, oral, 40 mg depending on response, daily.
Prednisone, oral, 7.5 mg daily for a maximum of 2 weeks.
Prednisone, oral, 40 mg daily for 5 days (Doctor prescribed).
Prednisone, oral, 2 mg/kg/day until a satisfactory response is obtained. · Continue treatment for a minimum of 4 weeks. · Taper dose slowly over several weeks while monitoring for relapse.
Prednisone, oral, 4 mg/kg/dose as a single daily dose for 4 days. · Stop after 4 days without tapering dose.
Prednisone, oral, 4 mg/kg/24 hours as a single daily dose for 4 days.
Prednisone, oral, for 6 weeks: · Week 1: 2 mg/kg/day, · Week 2: 1.5 mg/kg/day,
Prednisone, oral, 1–2 mg/kg as a single daily dose for 7 days.
Prednisone, oral, 2 mg/kg/dose as a single dose in the morning for 4 weeks. · Maximum dose: 60 mg daily.
Prednisone, oral, 2 mg/kg/dose as a single daily dose for minimum of one week. Urine test strips should be negative for minimum of 3 consecutive mornings before the dose is decreased.
Prednisone, oral, 0.5–1 mg/kg daily for 5 days.
Prednisone, oral, 1.5 mg/kg daily for 2 weeks, followed by 0.75 mg/kg daily for 2 weeks.

cautions.t: Taper after more than 3 weeks of treatment
Exclude TB and strongyloides before prolonged courses

adverse_effects.t: Hyperglycaemia, hypertension, fluid retention, mood change, insomnia, peptic ulcer, infection risk, adrenal suppression, osteoporosis, Cushingoid features with long-term use
